subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the final rebase and exact-head checks complete, should the grouped security-sensitive action pins be accepted as one update or split for separate rollout?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it changes third-party code that receives secrets, mints tokens, uploads security results, publishes images, and runs Codex; the protected security label reserves acceptance of that grouped operational risk for a maintainer.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Merge the grouped immutable-pin refresh once all required checks and representative sensitive workflow paths pass on the final rebased head.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate CodeQL, token, Docker publishing, and Codex updates for narrower rollout and rollback evidence.

options.title: Pause this refresh
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it without merge if a stable head cannot produce complete sensitive-workflow proof.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Merge the grouped immutable-pin refresh once all required checks and representative sensitive workflow paths pass on the final rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects him to release hardening and active agent workflow operation across the most sensitive changed paths.
